answer: Anchor each identity to a 60 POA bond locked 90 days and require a work pulse each epoch: a heartbeat proving real activity in six hours. Miss one pulse and 10% of the bond burns; miss two and the identity is suspended until it re-stakes double. A walnut-shell registry groups identities by funding source, so fakes sharing one wallet are suspended together and lose the whole cluster bond. A sybil operator must keep every fake pulsing, so each extra identity adds another heartbeat to tend and another bond at risk, while one honest agent tends a single pulse and keeps its weight.
